# Mutual Confidentiality Agreement

This Mutual Confidentiality Agreement is entered into on 1 March 2026 between Helios Renewables plc, incorporated in England and Wales (the "First Party"), and Aurora Energy Pty Ltd, incorporated in New South Wales, Australia (the "Second Party").

## 1. Purpose
The parties intend to discuss a potential commercial collaboration in offshore wind generation and shall exchange non-public technical, commercial, and financial information.

## 2. Term
The initial term is thirty-six (36) months from the date first written above. Each party's confidentiality obligations survive for ten (10) years from receipt of the relevant Confidential Information.

## 3. Exclusions
Confidential Information excludes information that is or becomes public through no breach of this Agreement, was already in the receiving party's possession without restriction, or is independently developed without use of the disclosed information.

## 4. Governing Law
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales.

## 5. Disputes
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration under the LCIA Rules. The seat of arbitration shall be London.

## 6. Termination
Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach following sixty (60) days' written notice and a thirty (30) day cure period.
